signin.title: Sign in to JKNet
signin.intro: Chat with your friends from your phone or your browser.
signin.waiting: Finish signing in on the page that opened.
signin.expired: The sign-in took too long. Try again.
signin.installFirst: On iPhone, add JKNet to the Home Screen first and sign in there: the installed app keeps its own sign-in.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Installed, JKNet opens from the home screen and can show notifications.
install.iosSteps: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.installed: JKNet is installed on this device.

tabs.title: JKNet is open in another tab
tabs.body: Only one tab stays connected at a time.

offline.banner: No connection. Messages wait and go out once you are back online.

update.available: A new version of JKNet is ready.
update.required: This version of JKNet is too old. Update to carry on.

notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked in the settings of the browser.

preview.full: Name and start of the message

push.test: Notifications from JKNet work on this device.
